title: feat(spec): a page object-form's thank-you panel is translated through pages.PAGE.components.ID.submitBehavior
body:
domain:spec#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibwb6hBqszPTYJobitm

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao1Jx7WKoJNdFZFmj4TXFV34)_

Fixes #28214

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up #28215 (skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md: the page row gains `components.{component_id}.submitBehavior` beside the `_views.{view_name}` row #28195 already owes, in the same next i18n skill edit)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：页面里嵌入的 `object-form` 组件，提交后的感谢页（`submitBehavior` 为 `thank-you` 时的 `title` / `message`）有了翻译键 `pages.PAGE.components.ID.submitBehavior.title` / `.message`，`translatePage` 会把它套到下发的页面上；提取器会生成这两个键，lint 会拒收挂错组件的键。
- 为什么改：表单视图自己的感谢页在 #28195 已经能翻译，但页面里的表单组件引用的是同一个配置却没有键，showcase 的“新建项目（向导）”在任何语言下创建成功后都显示英文的 “Project created”。
- 风险与回滚：只放宽（新增可选键）；规则与表单视图的感谢页共用同一个函数：只翻 thank-you、只翻作者写了的文案、缺键保留原文。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` 的 `translateFormSubmitBehavior`（改为两处共用）和 `translatePage` 里新增的 `object-form` 分支，`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` 的 `submitBehaviorTranslationSchema`，`packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts` 的页面组件检查。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/system/i18n-resolver.page-form-thank-you.test.ts`，预期 12 条全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（等契约复审记录）。

## What changes

A page `object-form` component takes `submitBehavior` from the form view by reference (`ObjectFormPropsSchema.submitBehavior`), so a page can author `{ kind: 'thank-you', title, message }` on it. #28195 gave a form view's panel its key and overlay. The page component's panel had neither: the strict `pages.PAGE.components.ID` entry declared no `submitBehavior`, and `translatePage` never read `properties.submitBehavior`. The showcase's `showcase_new_project_wizard` page confirmed a create with "Project created" in every locale.

- **Spec, the key (`translation.zod.ts`).** `pages.PAGE.components.ID` gains `submitBehavior: { title?, message? }` (strict). The node is built by a new factory, `submitBehaviorTranslationSchema(surface)`, which the form view's `_views.VIEW.submitBehavior` now uses too, so the two addresses carry one shape: the same alias table (`heading`, `text`, `body`, `description`) and the same `url` / `kind` prescriptions. This follows the `actionTranslationSchema` precedent in the same file. The components node's alias table gains `thankYou: 'submitBehavior'`, as the `_views` node has.
- **Spec, the overlay (`i18n-resolver.ts`).** `translateFormSubmitBehavior` is now the one comparison both carriers call. It takes a `lookup(attr)` instead of the view's object name and view key. `translateView` passes the `_views` lookup it used before. `translatePage` passes a new `lookupPageFormSubmitBehaviorText` (locale chain, key by key) for every addressed component whose type is the new exported `PAGE_FORM_COMPONENT_TYPE` (`'object-form'`), on the same `addressed` arbitration as the component copy, so a nested form is reached by the id route too. The rules are therefore the form view's, with no second copy: only a `kind: 'thank-you'` panel is touched, only an authored non-empty string is translated (a key cannot invent a `message`), and a missing key keeps the authored string. The component is returned unchanged when nothing applies.
- **The extractor (`packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts`).** A new `pushThankYouPanel(out, root, behavior, …)` emits the two slots and holds the "kind must be thank-you" reading once. `pushFormViewCopy` and `emitPageComponentCopy` both call it, so `os i18n extract` scaffolds `pages.PAGE.components.ID.submitBehavior.title` / `.message` for every `object-form` the page addresses, and the coverage report counts an authored panel a supported locale leaves untranslated. A non-thank-you kind records both keys unauthored, as on the view side.
- **The lint (`packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts`).** A `components.ID.submitBehavior` key is refused (`translation-target-unknown`) under a component the page declares with another type, and under an id the page does not declare, with the nearest `object-form` id offered. A page this stack does not declare is skipped, as for the tab items.
- **Showcase.** The wizard's `object-form` had no `id`, so it had no address at all. It gets `id: 'new_project_form'` (`examples/app-showcase/src/ui/pages/new-project-wizard.page.ts`), and `src/system/translations/index.ts` gains its zh-CN `title`, `description` and panel `title` / `message`. The id also makes the form's `title` and `description` addressable, which the coverage ratchet counts, so all four strings are translated and `check:i18n-coverage` stays at its baseline.
- **Generated.** `packages/spec/api-surface/system.json` and `export-origins/system.json` record the new `PAGE_FORM_COMPONENT_TYPE` export. `check:docs` and `check:strictness-ledger` stayed green with no regeneration (the generated translation reference renders the page node's `components` member collapsed).
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/28214-page-form-thank-you-translation.md`: `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/lint`, all `minor`, with both declaration lines.

**Address: route (a), under the page.** The key lives at `pages.PAGE.components.ID.submitBehavior`, the #6080 route `lookupPageComponentCopy` already serves for the same component's `title` and `description`.

**Route not taken: (b), under the bound object** (the `_sections` precedent, `objects.OBJECT._sections`). The panel is copy the page authors, not the object. Two pages binding the same object can word their confirmation differently (a create wizard and a quick-add card), and an object-scoped key would make them share one translation or need a page-scoped sub-key, which is route (a) spelled longer. `_sections` is object-scoped because a form section's fields are the object's fields. A thank-you panel has no such tie. Route (b) would also need a second walk to find the bound object (`objectName`, or a `dataSource` binding), while (a) reuses the id addressing the extractor, lint and resolver already share through `walkAddressedPageComponents`. The cost of (a) is that an `object-form` without an `id` has no key, the same rule every other page component follows. The showcase form gains an id for that reason.

**The page door runs the translator.** `translatePage` is the `page` entry of the translator table (`i18n-resolver.ts`, `page: translatePage`), which `/meta/page` reads go through (`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`, `translateMetadataDocument`). The console's `object-form` renderers take `submitBehavior` from the component's props (`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx`, `WizardForm.tsx`), so the translated panel reaches the reader with no ui change. This is a reading of the code, not a live measure.
- **Docs (seat-approved, commit `8837fd00`):** the `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx` key table gains both thank-you panel rows: the form view's `objects.NAME._views.VIEW.submitBehavior.title / .message` (which #28195 left out) and the page form's `pages.NAME.components.FORMID.submitBehavior.title / .message`.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.page-form-thank-you.test.ts` (new, 12): parsed fixtures (the page through `PageSchema`, both bundle nodes through `TranslationDataSchema`). A zh-CN overlay through `translateMetadataDocument('page', …)`, with the form's own `title` translated beside it and a form nested in a `page:card` reached by id. The fallback chain (ja-JP over `[zh-CN]`). A missing key keeps the authored panel. Controls: a panel with no `message` gains none; a `redirect` behavior is untouched; a key under another component's id does not reach the form, and a `page:card` with a `submitBehavior` key gains no panel; the panel key and the component `title` key do not cross; an `object-form` without an id has no key; no mutation. The schema face: `url` refused as `unrecognized_keys` at the page path, and `kind` refused with the prescription.
- `packages/cli/test/i18n-page-form-thank-you-coverage.test.ts` (new, 4): the walker emits both slots per addressed `object-form`, nested ones included, and none for an id-less form or a `page:card`; authored copy seeds, unauthored and non-thank-you copy does not; the extracted skeleton parses; coverage reports exactly the authored strings zh-CN leaves untranslated, and none once covered.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.test.ts` (+4): a panel over a declared `object-form`, nested included, reports nothing; refused on a `page:card` by name; refused under an undeclared id with `Did you mean "project_form"?`; a page the stack does not declare is not judged.
- The existing `i18n-resolver.form-thank-you.test.ts` (11) stays green through the refactor of `translateFormSubmitBehavior`.

<details><summary>Ablation: removing the page overlay branch turns the overlay cases red</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts --anchor 'if (addressed && component.type === PAGE_FORM_COMPONENT_TYPE) {' --replacement 'if (false as boolean) { /* ABLATED-28214 */'`. The anchor hit once (1 → 0, blob `dfefaad6` → `8ebe517f`). The new spec test went to Tests 4 failed | 8 passed (12): the zh-CN overlay, the fallback chain, the no-message control and the title/panel crossing control. The other controls stayed green, as expected, since they assert that nothing is applied. The file was restored to its HEAD blob `dfefaad6`, `git diff HEAD` empty. The test imports the resolver from source, so no `dist` rebuild is involved.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **No packaged-base comparison on pages.** `translateFormSubmitBehavior` applies ADR-0029 D9.2a (an override beats the catalog) when its caller hands it the packaged config. `translatePage` takes `ResolveOptions` and no packaged base for any string (its `label`, `description`, header copy and component copy all apply the catalog unconditionally), so the page call passes `undefined` and the panel follows the page's existing rule. The comparison is still the one function, so a later card that hands `translatePage` its packaged base gets the panel for free. Noted, not filed.
- **The wizard's form section labels** (`Basics`, `Health`, `Budget & Schedule`) and their descriptions stay untranslatable on a page form: `object-form`'s `properties.sections` has no page key, and `_sections` addresses an object's form sections, not a page component's. Outside this card. Noted, not filed.
- **File surface.** `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/pages/new-project-wizard.page.ts` is outside the claim's surface. Route (a) needs the form to carry an `id`, and the showcase form had none, so the showcase strings could not land without it (4 added lines, the `id` and a comment).
